faqs.question: Which Bradford school district is covered here?
faqs.answer: This is Bradford County School District in Florida. Its 2026-2027 student calendar is available here, with the district PDF and notes on the planning days whose student schedules need confirmation.

faqs.question: Does the employee holiday table apply to students?
faqs.answer: The annual document has a separate 256 Day Employee Holidays section. Use the student calendar for school attendance. Employee vacation days, calendar adjustment days and staff holiday hours do not establish additional days off for students.

faqs.question: Have Bradford calendars for 2027-2028 through 2029-2030 been added?
faqs.answer: No verified calendar for those years has been added here. Check the district’s School Calendar page for a later release, and use that year’s dates rather than carrying forward the current schedule.

editorialSummary.heading: When school resumes after winter and spring breaks
paragraphs: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. Monday, March 29, is a teacher planning day and student holiday, so classes resume Tuesday, March 30.

Winter Holidays run December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students also have January 4 off for teacher planning and return January 5. The first semester ends January 8, with the second starting January 11.

The district also lists a Professional Development Day on February 12 and a Virtual Planning Day on April 23. Neither entry says whether students attend school, and no remote-learning instructions are provided for April 23. Check with your child's school before treating either date as a day off.

Families can view progress reports and report cards through the district's FOCUS Parent Portal. The calendar lists report cards for October 22, January 20 and April 1, and progress reports for September 23, December 2, February 23 and May 3. Graduation is May 21, while the last student day is May 26.

Friday, December 18, 2026, is an early-release school day before Winter Holidays. Students attend that day, but the district calendar does not give a dismissal time. Check the school notice for pickup and bus arrangements.

about.dataSource: The source is Bradford County School District’s 2026-2027 Official School Calendar linked from its current School Calendar page. The local PDF and downloaded official file have the same SHA-256. Both PDF pages were reviewed: the dates and separate employee holiday table are on page 1; page 2 is blank. District event details were checked for the two staff dates without a stated student schedule.
about.processing: Only the student calendar supplies holidays and milestones. Pre-planning, post-planning and the entire 256 Day Employee Holidays table are excluded from student events, including employee Calendar Adjustment Days, vacation-hour allocations and Memorial Day after the student year. The named winter and spring holiday ranges remain canonical events; planning summaries add only the adjacent, explicit student holidays on January 4 and March 29. Twenty-eight confirmed no-class weekdays are counted. No annual student attendance total is calculated because February 12 and April 23 are unresolved, and the PDF prints no student-day total. No hurricane make-up policy, graduation time, report-card final release or early-release clock time is inferred.
about.updates: The official PDF, School Calendar page, district homepage, Public Announcements and district event entries were checked October 15, 2026. The February 12 and April 23 event popups repeat the PDF labels without explaining student attendance. The filename says Approved, but no Board adoption or revision date is printed in the reviewed PDF; approval-date metadata stays unset.
about.disclaimer: Ask your school about student attendance on February 12 and April 23, December 18 pickup, graduation arrangements and any later calendar changes. A staff planning label alone does not establish student time off or remote instruction.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Bradford County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day for students is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. August 3–10 is staff pre-planning.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Bradford County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. May 27 is scheduled for staff post-planning, not another regular student day.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Bradford County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving holidays run from Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter or Christmas break for Bradford County schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Winter Holidays, running from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4, is a separate teacher planning day and student holiday. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Do Bradford County students return on January 4 or January 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5. January 4 is marked Teacher Planning Day - Student Holiday, so there are no regular classes that Monday.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Bradford County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students also have Monday, March 29, off for teacher planning.

faqs.question: When do Bradford County students return after spring break?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, March 30, 2027. Although Spring Break ends March 26, Monday, March 29, is a separate student holiday.

faqs.question: Does Bradford County have a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: The official 2026-2027 calendar does not list a week-long fall break. Students have Friday, October 16, off for teacher planning. October 13 marks the end of the first nine weeks but is not listed as a student holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on September 14, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 14, is a Professional Development Day - Student Holiday. Students do not have regular classes that day.

faqs.question: Do Bradford County students have school on October 16, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, October 16, is a Teacher Planning Day - Student Holiday. Combined with the weekend, it gives students three consecutive days without regular classes.

faqs.question: What holidays do Bradford County schools have off in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Labor Day on September 7, 2026; Veterans Day on November 11, 2026; Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027; and Presidents Day on February 15, 2027. Thanksgiving Holidays, Winter Holidays and Spring Break have their own scheduled dates.

faqs.question: Is February 12, 2027, a day off for Bradford County students?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Friday, February 12, as a Professional Development Day but does not label it a Student Holiday. The district event listing also does not clarify student attendance. Check with your school before treating it as a day off.

faqs.question: Are Bradford County schools closed for Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027, is a listed school holiday. Friday, February 12, is a professional development day with an unspecified student schedule, so a four-day weekend is not confirmed.

faqs.question: Is April 23, 2027, a virtual learning day or a school holiday?
faqs.answer: The calendar calls Friday, April 23, Virtual Planning Day but does not say whether students attend school, complete online assignments or have the day off. Check your school's instructions rather than assuming any of those arrangements.

faqs.question: When is early release for Bradford County schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, December 18, 2026, is the only early-release date identified in the district's annual school calendar. It comes immediately before the winter holidays.

faqs.question: What time does school get out on December 18, 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not provide an early-dismissal time for December 18. Check your school for pickup times, bus schedules and any changes to after-school arrangements.

faqs.question: Is the last day of school, May 26, 2027, an early-release day?
faqs.answer: The official annual calendar does not mark May 26 as an early-release day. It is listed as the last day for students. Confirm dismissal arrangements with your school, particularly if a later notice is issued.

faqs.question: When does the second semester start in Bradford County?
faqs.answer: The second semester begins Monday, January 11, 2027. The first semester ends Friday, January 8. Students return from winter break earlier, on January 5.

faqs.question: When do Bradford County grading periods end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The official calendar lists October 13, 2026, as the end of the first nine weeks, January 8, 2027, as the end of the first semester, and March 15, 2027, as the end of the third nine weeks. It does not separately identify an end date for the fourth nine weeks.

faqs.question: When are Bradford County school report cards issued in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists first-quarter report cards for October 22, 2026, second-quarter report cards for January 20, 2027, and third-quarter report cards for April 1, 2027. It does not provide a fourth-quarter report-card release date.

faqs.question: When are progress reports available for Bradford County students?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 23 and December 2, 2026, and February 23 and May 3, 2027. The district's Parent & Student Resources page says families can view, download and print progress reports through the FOCUS Parent Portal. The annual calendar does not specify an exact posting time.

faqs.question: When is Bradford County graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Graduation is listed for Friday, May 21, 2027. The annual calendar does not provide a ceremony time or location. The district's last student day remains May 26, so families should check their graduating student's school for ceremony and senior-schedule details.

faqs.question: Do employee holidays on the Bradford County calendar mean students are also off?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. The annual PDF has a separate 256 Day Employee Holidays section for staff. Those dates do not establish additional student holidays. Use the student calendar to identify confirmed days without classes.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Bradford County school calendar for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The Bradford County School District's School Calendar page links the 2026-2027 Official School Calendar PDF. It includes student holidays, grading dates, early release, graduation and staff planning days.

faqs.question: Where should parents check for school calendar changes or closures?
faqs.answer: Check the district's School Calendar page, District Events Calendar and messages from your child's school. These are especially important for dates such as February 12 and April 23, when the annual PDF does not specify the student attendance schedule.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days are confirmed student holidays in Bradford County?
faqs.answer: Four staff workdays are explicitly marked Student Holiday: September 14 and October 16, 2026, and January 4 and March 29, 2027. September 14 is a professional development day, while the other three are teacher planning days. Student attendance is not specified for the February 12 Professional Development Day or the April 23 Virtual Planning Day.

faqs.question: How can Bradford County parents view report cards and progress reports online?
faqs.answer: Parents can use the district's FOCUS Parent Portal to view, download and print report cards and progress reports. The portal is linked from Bradford County School District's Parent & Student Resources page. Families who cannot print a report card can contact their child's school for a printed copy.
